verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own docs say it provides an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and OpenAI-compatible APIs, and call it a drop-in replacement for migrating from OpenAI with the same API. The serverless docs state that you point your client at api.fireworks.ai, which matches the change-the-base-URL workflow. missing for 10: an explicit OpenAI SDK snippet showing only base_url and api_key changed (including the exact path), independent or hands-on corroboration that existing OpenAI SDK clients work unmodified.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: Fireworks provides an OpenAI compatible endpoint.
Fireworks provides fast, cost-effective access to leading open-source text models through OpenAI-compatible APIs.
Migrate from OpenAI: Drop-in replacement for inference and training — same API, same SFT data format
You point your client at `api.fireworks.ai`, send tokens, and pay only for what you use
